verdict.rationale: OpenHands' site describes an automation that watches for new bugs or incidents, gathers logs and recent changes, suggests severity, and routes the issue to the right owner. That matches the story directly. Automations can run on GitHub and Linear webhook events, and a related SDK guide assigns PR reviewers via git blame, which shows owner-routing logic exists. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on configuring the issue-triage automation (severity criteria, owner-mapping rules), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.
